description: The catalog placeholder grammar ({name}, {{ and }} escapes, ^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$ names) is scanned by the three runtime interpreters and, separately, by the catalog validator and the native resource generator, which pre-tokenize the same templates at build time.
note: The two build-time copies are what the runtime copies are generated from and validated by, so a grammar change must touch all five together or the generator silently emits tokens the runtimes cannot reproduce. Nothing mechanically ties the build-time pair to the runtime trio; the runtime trio is covered by tests/localization/cases.json, and the build-time pair by its own script tests.
